ASSISTANT (message): **TLDR: roughly one H100-day (~$50–80 rented) for a full-context run over the whole dataset, or ~4 hours (~$10) if you cap context at 32k. A single 80 GB GPU is enough — Qwen3.5's hybrid attention makes "high context" much cheaper than it sounds. The pipeline now supports Qwen3.5-9B natively, smoke-tested end-to-end, with the vision tower provably untouched.**

First, what I verified before estimating (Qwen3.5 is past my cutoff): it's a March 2026 release, early-fusion multimodal, 262K native context, and — the key fact for your question — a hybrid architecture where only 8 of 32 text layers use full attention (GQA, 4 KV heads); the other 24 are Gated DeltaNet linear attention. So long-context cost scales near-linearly, KV cache is only ~32 KB/token, and there's no quadratic blowup even at 140k tokens.
